children: Japanese stocks may rise after U.S. stocks surged overnight, led by Nvidia. Nikkei futures are up 3.0% at 57840 on the SGX. The dollar is at 158.98 yen, compared with Y159.17 as of Friday's Tokyo stock market close. Japanese markets were closed Monday for a public holiday. Investors are focusing on crude oil prices and bond yields. The Nikkei Stock Average fell 5.1% to 56436.65 on Friday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)
